capabilities: Sync notes, folders and attachments to a WebDAV server over HTTPS
Connect multiple devices to a shared remote vault by ID
Merge independent edits automatically and prompt on overlapping conflicts
Sync Obsidian settings and optionally plugins between Windows computers
Run automatic syncs at startup, after edits, or on an interval with retries
extras: Free plugin with no client-side encryption and no telemetry; the storage provider can read uploaded data. Detailed instructions and troubleshooting live on linked pages outside the README.
problem: Obsidian's built-in sync options require a paid service or third-party sync tools; this plugin lets users sync vaults through their own WebDAV storage for free.

relations.evidence: Check and update opens TotalSync's native Obsidian catalog page. Obsidian handles installation; BRAT is optional for test releases.

summary: Syncs notes, files, settings and plugins across devices via the user's own WebDAV server, with automatic conflict merging and scheduled or manual runs.
